notes.title: Challenge The Developer!
notes.content:
Hey Folks!

Hope you are all having fun Tossing Rag Doll Joe everywhere! 

Let's get down to business.  I have setup a challenge between the community and my self ( The Developer ) . This challenge involves user review count vs content updates, so that means 
If the User reviews reach 500 reviews or more by December 21 2019, I will add additional content for Rag Doll Joe. 

Which will include the following:

- Additional character ( Joe wont be alone no more! )
- 10 more levels ( Which will include 10 new objects)
- A new game mode? O_o 
- Additional Feature ( What will it be?)

Remember, The user review count must reach 500 reviews by December 21 2019!
GOOD LUCK!

Sincerely,
GritStudios
